findings.message: Hideout art is a GENERATED_REVIEW fragment (web/manifests/hideout.json uses entries, not assets). Files are present, none are missing, and none exceed 400 KB. Ids such as HOU_TIER_CABIN already exist in web/assets-manifest.json, which matches the stream note that this fragment must not be copied into the live catalog yet. The running hideout still uses the existing house art.

The Stash, Inventory, Collection, and Deck screens render. At 667×375, 844×390, 932×430, and 1280×720 every measured control is at least 44 CSS px, 22 cards are visible, and there were no page errors. The section sets data-collection-route and does not set data-screen=stash, so a waiter on [data-screen=stash] does not resolve. Back returns to the hideout. Map, prep, battle, rewards, and gacha still open. npm test on the merged tree is 457/448/0 with one extra todo: collection screens at landscape viewports, because Playwright is not installed in the repo.

prod/e-battle-polish conflicts with prod/c-inventory in web/index.html. Both insert a stylesheet link on the line after css/app.css (collection.css and battle-polish.css). web/js/app.js auto-merges. E merges cleanly onto prod/wave-base by itself. This pass left E out of the throwaway tree, so battle-polish.css was not on the screens that were played.
Sport art landed as a review manifest (productionReady false). No missing files and no raster at or above 400 KB from this stream. The live Sports Complex pin is still locked.
World content tests pass. The proposed copy is in content/prod/world. The live map still shows the wave-base pin labels, including the overlapping Sports Complex / Coming soon pair.
